spaf.ayuda_titulo: How to check the SPAF Table
spaf.ayuda: SPAF is the Family Prevention and Support Service. Choose a completed month. The table includes cases accepted before the end of that month which were not closed before its first day. Admissions and closures use effective acceptance and closure dates. The breakdown shows which case numbers are counted. “No data” means the information is missing; it does not mean zero. Names appear as initials in the preview. The Word document contains available full names. Downloading it does not confirm any milestone.
spaf.movimiento_no_disponible: This case no longer appears in that month’s table. Return to the SPAF Table and check the figures.
spaf.recuperado: We have recovered the original Word document and started the download. Check its data: it may differ from the current preview.
